subject: Marketplace entry triage: eligibility, regions, and co-sell staging
messages:
From: Elena Moroz <elena@cloudscale.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in listing + co-sell for CloudScale AI Ops

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks again for the intro last week. CloudScale is targeting a Q3 launch for our managed AI Ops product and we want to explore listing on AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces — and ideally enable co-sell on AWS. Can you help confirm the following so we can align our internal roadmap?

- Eligibility checklist for marketplace listing (legal, technical, billing).
- Which SKU granularity Redwood recommends for multi-cloud (single metered SKU vs. cloud-specific SKUs).
- Minimum regional footprint typically required for co-sell/BYOL vs. SaaS offers.
- What documentation you’ll need from us to start partner/onboarding.

I've attached a short requirements doc and our expected timeline. Our procurement lead is copied on subsequent threads; for now I can be the main contact.

Attachments: cloudscale_intro_requirements.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

Best,
Elena
Head of Partnerships
CloudScale Inc.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moroz <elena@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in listing + co-sell for CloudScale AI Ops

Hi Elena — great to hear you're moving toward Q3. Quick triage below; can we schedule a 30-min call this week to walk the checklist? I'll bring Jonas (marketplace ops) and Marcus (co-sell/GTMS).

Top-level answers:
- Eligibility: basic legal + security attestation, billing entity details, and an operational contact. For AWS co-sell we'll also need a partner status (APN) and some sales enablement assets (1-pager + trial onboarding flow).
- SKU strategy: two common patterns: 1) single SaaS metered SKU (simpler ops, one offer across clouds) or 2) cloud-specific offers when you need cloud-native provisioning / AMI/VM artifacts. Recommend pattern (1) unless you require cloud-specific infra variants.
- Regional footprint: for co-sell, AWS prefers presence in at least two commercial regions and a documented latency profile. Azure/GCP listing can be global SaaS but partner incentives vary by region.
- Docs we need from you: W-9 / billing entity, SOC2 summary (or timeline), trial provisioning doc, and a short integration diagram.

Please review the attached co-sell checklist I just sent (marketplace_co-sell_checklist.xlsx).

Proposed call slots (PST): Thu 5/6 10:00 or Fri 5/7 14:00. Which works?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in listing + co-sell for CloudScale AI Ops

Looping in a short internal note from marketplace ops — shoved into the thread so Elena sees our baseline later.

Soojin / Marcus / Laura — quick recommendations based on their ask and our playbooks:

1) Offer model: publish a single SaaS metered offer per cloud control plane (one SKU sku_saas_monthly_metered). Rationale: lowers listing overhead, simplifies CPM and usage analytics in Redwood Console. If CloudScale needs an AMI/VM for on-prem customers, add a second BYOL AMI offer later.

2) Regions: recommend staging - US-WEST-2 + US-EAST-1 at launch for AWS (co-sell visibility), EU-WEST-1 if they have EU customers. Azure: West US + North Europe. GCP: us-central1 + europe-west1. Start with 2 regions per cloud, expand based on demand.

3) Packaging/pricing: list a single metered plan with optional seat-based add-on. Keep pricing bands coarse (Starter / Growth / Enterprise) to speed approval.

4) Co-sell prerequisites: APN registration, a sales play (one-pager + enablement slide deck), and a sandbox account we can use to generate sample invoices for AWS partner ops.

Action items for us before call: 1) finalize our recommended SKU string and sample offer text (Marcus). 2) Draft enablement one-pager (Laura). 3) Share sample invoice and latency SLO template (Jonas).

-Jonas
Marketplace Ops
From: Elena Moroz <elena@cloudscale.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudscale.com
Date: 2027-05-06T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in listing + co-sell for CloudScale AI Ops

Thanks team — Thu 5/6 10:00 works for Soojin's timezone; we're set. A few clarifications ahead of the call:

- Procurement timeline: legal review completes by 6/15; procurement needs an MSA redline and a sample PO flow.
- Discounting: we have preliminary pricing targets; would Redwood consider a launch credit or co-marketing fund tied to co-sell performance?
- SOC2: we have a Type II in progress; expecting cert by end of June. For now we can provide the control summary and SOC2 roadmap.

We'll attach the procurement calendar during the call.

Best,
Elena
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moroz <elena@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Ops <partner-ops@awsmarketplace.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Interest in listing + co-sell for CloudScale AI Ops

Elena — excellent sync today. Summary + next steps (action owners in parentheses):

1) Offer & SKUs: publish 1 SaaS metered offer per cloud at launch; add BYOL/AMI as a secondary offer if needed. We will circulate a recommended SKU string and sample offer text by 5/11. (Marcus)

2) Regions: AWS: us-west-2 + us-east-1 initial; Azure: westus + northeurope; GCP: us-central1 + europe-west1. We'll add EU-WEST-1 if you confirm EU demand. (Jonas)

3) Co-sell & enablement: Redwood can commit to co-marketing credits tied to MRR milestones (template below). Marcus to propose a launch-credit structure by 5/12. For AWS co-sell, we'll begin the APN uplift checklist now. (Marcus / Jonas)

4) Docs needed from CloudScale: billing entity + W-9, SOC2 control summary (or timeline), procurement calendar, and a 1-pager + sandbox access for enablement. (Elena)

5) Contracts & procurement: Laura will draft a sample PO flow and redline guidance for MSA by 5/15. We can accommodate a pilot credit in the PO for launch. (Laura)

Attachments referenced: marketplace_co-sell_checklist.xlsx, redwood_listing_guidelines_v3.pdf.

Related links: HubSpot deal CS-2027-0412 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345678) and the partner onboarding doc (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xX-marketplace-plan).

Next meeting: 5/13 09:00 PT to review SKU text and credit proposal.

Thanks everyone — I'll send the consolidated checklist and a short enablement template after this mail.
